translations.web: The elder and the honorable man is the head, and the prophet who teaches lies is the tail.
translations.bsb: The head is the elder and honorable man, and the tail is the prophet who teaches lies.
translations.kjv: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
translations.asv: The elder and the honorable man, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
